publisher_name: Cartography Magazine (Paola Corini and Luca De Santis, founding publishers)
independence_evidence: About page: 'Cartography is an independent magazine devoted to travel culture ... established in 2016 by Paola Corini and Luca De Santis, Cartography Magazine is based in Milan'; the founders are named as 'Founding Publishers' and the address is Via Savona 97, Milan.
qualifies_reason: Self-described independent Milan travel magazine whose twelfth print issue was released internationally on 12 April 2025.
what_it_is: Cartography is a large-format travel magazine in English and Italian; each issue takes three destinations (N°12: Brazil, La Gomera to Tangier, and West Texas) and covers each with a documentary photo album, a short text, a map and a day-by-day itinerary. Issues run to around 300 pages at 245 x 335 mm on uncoated paper and are collected as much as read. It suits travellers and photography readers who prefer slow itineraries over hotel listings.

uncertainties: The publisher says it is 'published twice a year', but the actual cadence is slower: N°11 appeared in early 2024 (cover files uploaded January 2024) and N°12 in April 2025, with no N°13 found by November 2026, so 'annual' is recorded per the cadence rule. The price EUR 29 is the publisher's stated IT/EU cover price on the release post (UK GBP 27, US USD 34); the shop page itself is script-rendered and showed no prices. No legal company name is given on the site. The distributor hint (Issue 12 listed Oct 2025) matches.
